blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and the United Kingdom have entered into a regionalization scheme that will ensure stable pork supply from Britain. Through Department Circular No. 58, the Department of Agriculture (DA) granted Britain’s bilateral recognition of regionalization for African swine fever (ASF), covering live swine and their products, including pork and genetic materials.
